core_meaning.primary_meaning: Moemen is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Believer, one who has faith”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Moemen corresponds to the Arabic form مؤمن (Arabic root أ م ن (ʾ-m-n); مُؤْمِن (Muʾmin)). Its core sense is believer, one who has faith. Moemen is Arabic مُؤْمِن (Muʾmin) 'believer, one who has faith', from the root أ م ن (ʾ-m-n). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave معمن (a different form); the correct form is مُؤْمِن. The source gloss 'Believer, one who trusts and relies on God' is broadly consistent. Same name as momin.
